question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'A person who loves and collects books'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2) Bibliophile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Philatelist"** refers to a person who collects or studies stamps. (डाक टिकट संग्राहक)
 
 
• **Example:** My uncle is a philatelist and owns a remarkable collection of rare stamps.
 
 

 
• The word **"Bibliophile"** refers to a person who loves and collects books. (पुस्तक प्रेमी)
 
 
• **Example:** As a bibliophile, she spent hours browsing bookstores and adding rare editions to her collection.
 
 

 
• Hence, the correct one-word substitute for "A person who loves and collects books" is **"Bibliophile."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2) Bibliophile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Philatelist** (डाक टिकट संग्राहक): A person who collects or studies stamps.
 
 
• **Example:** The philatelist displayed his collection of rare stamps at the exhibition.
 
 

 
• **Calligrapher** (सुलेखक): A person skilled in the art of beautiful handwriting.
 
 
• **Example:** The wedding invitations were crafted by a professional calligrapher.
 
 

 
• **Archivist** (संग्रहपाल): A person responsible for preserving and organizing historical records or documents.
 
 
• **Example:** The archivist spent years cataloging the ancient manuscripts.
